messages:
ana: ops noticed spike in fncall schema rejects in eu-west for a dedicated tenant; requests fallback to degen and billing shows token charges. anyone triaging?
dave: alert? query?
ana: `fncall.schema_reject_rate{region="eu-west"}` -> 0.9% over 5m; tenant acct-kappa impacted. sample: "validation_error: expected object for tool_args, got array" payload: ["x"]
priya: gateway emits billable event pre-validate; propose tagging events with validation_status=reject and billable=false so billing ignores them.
dave: add metric fncall.validation_rejects_total{route,account,reason} and trace tags validator_version, validation_reason. sample 1% payloads to S3.
ana: console: add small panel per-account for validation rejects + sanitized sample viewer. support wants evidence for credits.
billingbot: billing team: will accept zero-rate tag for immediate mitigation; retro credits require finance approval.
srebot: deploy plan: gateway tag -> canary in dedicated -> monitor 30m -> billing pipeline patch -> console update.
priya: owners: ana support comms, dave gateway + telemetry, priya billing change + deploy. will page SRE at >1% for 10m.
